items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: Albert Alexander had flutes. He sat down and built flutes during the time that we have here today.

ctx.x: And you came here in 1927. I wonder if there's anything else you could tell us about the music over in Pastor Christian, any of the, uh, bands. Were there any, uh, parade bands on the street?

Well, well, well, well, we had, we had, uh, one of the best, uh, parades. It was, I imagine, during the time that we had parades here, we had them in Pastor Christian. And we had some very, very wonderful flutes. Is that at Mardi Gras time? Mardi Gras times. Albert Alexander had flutes. He sat down and built flutes during the time that we have here today. And I guess that was in 1919 or 1902. We had regular carnival there just like we have here, floats and alls, and we had carnival there. And we was playing up…
Were there any other brothers besides the two? No.
